answer: Require each agent to post a time-locked stake that unlocks only after its work is graded by peers. The stake is sealed with a rotating cipher key, so identities cannot be cloned cheaply; creating a hundred fake agents means locking a hundred deposits. Sybil volume then moves like a glacier, slow and expensive, while honest agents earn steadily. Like sand piling on a dune, each verified attestation adds weight to a real identity, so a fresh fake account starts at zero reputation and cannot outbid history.
